LanguageData.ItemReroll_CommandDesc: Development mode: re-roll this item's random properties within the same range the game uses when it creates the item. What gets re-rolled is chosen in the mod settings.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_CommandDescRelic: Development mode: re-roll this relic's weapon traits. The weapon type, material and Legendary quality are set by the ideoligion and stay as they are.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_SettingsIntro: The Reroll button appears on items only in development mode. Choose what it re-rolls. Every roll stays inside the range the game itself uses for that item.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_TraitsDesc: Unique weapons (Odyssey, 1-3 traits) and persona weapons (Royalty, 1-2 traits). Traits are drawn from the same pool as the game: by weapon category, with the same weights, and without conflicting traits. A bonded persona weapon keeps its bond unless a new trait forbids bonding.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_NameAndColor: Name and color of unique weapons
LanguageData.ItemReroll_NameAndColorDesc: A new random color (or the color a trait forces) and a new name built from it. Not applied to relics: their name comes from the ideoligion. When off, the color still changes if a trait forces one.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_QualityDesc: Rolled the same way the game rolls a fresh unique weapon. Only unique weapons: for other items the game does not remember which quality range the item came from. Relics always stay Legendary.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_StuffDesc: Any other material the game may generate this item from, weighted the same way. Hit points keep their percentage. Not applied to relics: their material is set by the ideoligion.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_ArtDesc: A new art title and description from a random tale, for items good enough to carry art. The author stays the same.
LanguageData.ItemReroll_RelicNote: Relics: only weapon traits are re-rolled (and the color, if a trait forces it). Weapon type, material, quality and name never change.
